Published in *Scientific Data*. [doi:10.1038/s41597-025-06524-1](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-025-06524-1)

A knowledge-graph dataset linking 1.27 million Wikipedia articles across 11 language editions to 752 thousand taxonomic entities of the GBIF backbone taxonomy. The dataset itself is archived on Figshare — see [Data & Software](../../data-software/items/biowikinet-dataset.qmd).
